build.outcome: Implement the smallest end-to-end change that satisfies the request.

skills.name: outcome-prompt
skills.when: Substantive work; preserve an existing accepted contract.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.when: A module interface or seam needs design.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.when: Terminology or a domain decision changes.

skills.name: tdd
skills.when: Test-first work was requested or the project requires it.

skills.name: principle-boundary-discipline
skills.when: External input or framework wiring changes.

skills.name: principle-type-system-discipline
skills.when: The language is statically typed.

skills.name: typescript-best-practices
skills.when: Reading or editing TypeScript.

skills.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
skills.when: The path can retry, duplicate or restart.

skills.name: create-verification-skill
skills.when: No existing project behavior-verification skill exists.

inputs: Current project instructions, issue/spec and baseline behavior.
steps: Establish data shape, interface and acceptance before wiring.
Implement one complete path.
Use the project verification skill; select one suitable review if required.
build.check: Exercise the real interface and relevant regressions. Include retry, duplicate and restart checks for persistence.
build.stop: Acceptance passes, or a concrete missing prerequisite/permission blocks the next step. A build does not imply PR or merge authority.
build.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

debug.outcome: Find and repair the mechanism behind an observed failure.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.when: A failure or measured slowdown needs diagnosis.

skills.name: diagnose-crash
skills.when: A process produced a core dump on this machine.

skills.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
skills.when: The defect concerns retries or lifecycle recovery.

inputs: Exact reproduction, expected/actual behavior, logs and authoritative checkout.
steps: Reproduce on the user-facing interface.
Eliminate hypotheses with runtime evidence.
Repair the proven cause and replay the original case.
debug.check: Original failing input now passes and relevant nearby behavior is exercised.
debug.stop: Root cause verified or evidence/access missing; no speculative fixes.
debug.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

spec.outcome: Turn the chosen idea into a buildable, falsifiable specification.

skills.name: product-manager
skills.when: Ordinary feature specification or scope clarification.

skills.name: prd-loop
skills.when: A project idea has survived idea-teardown and needs the full reviewed project plan.

skills.name: grilling
skills.when: User explicitly requests an interview or stress test.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.when: Ticket decomposition was requested; check tracker write authorization.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.when: The plan spans more than one session and decision mapping is requested.

inputs: Original brief, intended user, evidence, constraints and chosen project.
steps: Select product-manager or prd-loop according to scope.
Resolve consequential uncertainty using sources before questions.
Write non-goals, acceptance, dependencies and first slice.
spec.check: Trace original constraints to falsifiable acceptance criteria and actual checks.
spec.stop: Specification meets scope; preserve the selected leaf workflow's build/read-back gates.
spec.boundary: Tracker publication and implementation retain their actual authorization; broad rstack setup is not a standing grant.

review.outcome: Review the requested artifact against its actual contract.

skills.name: code-review
skills.when: A diff since a fixed point or PR needs Standards and Spec review.

skills.name: code-reviewer
skills.when: A whole-codebase prove-and-fix audit was requested.

skills.name: contest-audit
skills.when: A smart-contract contest/security audit was requested.

skills.name: sol-loop
skills.when: User requests a Sol second opinion or delivery workflow selects it.

skills.name: council
skills.when: User explicitly requests council or a multi-provider review.

inputs: Exact artifact revision, baseline, specification and raw verification evidence.
steps: Choose one review workflow matching scope.
Verify findings with concrete source or reproductions.
Retain dispositions, dissent and uncovered scope.
review.check: Findings identify exact affected behavior and evidence; required providers actually participated.
review.stop: One shared repair allowance when applicable, then the prescribed verification. Do not stack review panels by default.
review.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

deliver.outcome: Reach the explicitly requested PR endpoint.

skills.name: file-pr
skills.when: Only PR filing or description update was requested.

skills.name: full-stop
skills.when: User requests end-to-end PR readiness without merging.

skills.name: full-send
skills.when: User explicitly authorizes autonomous merging.

skills.name: babysit-pr
skills.when: An existing PR needs monitoring.

skills.name: modernize
skills.when: An old PR needs reassessment and rebase.

skills.name: takeover
skills.when: The user asks to finish someone else's PR or thread.

skills.name: leaving-pr-comments
skills.when: Posting an authorized comment or review reply.

inputs: Original intent, exact branch/head, existing task ownership and external-action authority.
steps: Choose the requested lifecycle endpoint.
Follow leaf proof, review, attribution and T3 linking/watching rules.
Preserve protections and existing merge gates.
deliver.check: Check exact-head tests, reviews and merge eligibility; local CI is not a hosted check.
deliver.stop: Requested endpoint reached or a concrete gate remains; reconcile and unwatch on handoff.
deliver.boundary: No merge from a generic build request. No message send from draft formatting.

verify.outcome: Establish behavior proof through the project's real interface.

skills.name: create-verification-skill
skills.when: The project lacks a behavior verification workflow.

skills.name: maintain-verification-skill
skills.when: User asks to audit/refresh a drifted verification map.

skills.name: verify-operations-hub
skills.when: Verifying the private operations hub.

skills.name: verify-orbit-fitness
skills.when: Verifying Orbit Fitness.

inputs: Project start/drive commands, acceptance, isolated fixtures and exact artifact.
steps: Use the owning project verification skill before a generator.
Run actual user paths in isolation.
Save observations and platform limitations.
verify.check: Observe behavior, persistence and relevant failure/retry cases through interfaces.
verify.stop: Requested features exercised or exact unavailable platform/tool named.
verify.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

resume.outcome: Recover current task state without duplicating active work.

skills.name: context-compaction
skills.when: Long work needs a factual checkpoint or compaction recovery.

skills.name: notes-index
skills.when: Past decisions or notes need source retrieval.

skills.name: takeover
skills.when: Taking over another owner's task/PR is explicitly requested.

inputs: Current artifacts, task IDs, pending gates, source versions and attempt limits.
steps: Read current state and reconcile execution ownership.
Open source passages behind historical decisions.
Resume only the remaining authorized work.
resume.check: Current checkout and artifacts agree with checkpoint; uncertain active runs remain owned.
resume.stop: Next eligible slice is known or ownership/evidence blocks progress.
resume.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

improve-skill.outcome: Locate and evaluate a workflow failure before changing its guidance.

skills.name: skill-step-eval
skills.when: A named skill or workflow behaves unreliably.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.when: Creating or editing the skill after the problem is established.

skills.name: skill-installer
skills.when: Installation from a curated source/repo was requested.

inputs: Named skill, representative raw input, baseline output and failing acceptance.
steps: Map observable steps and identify the earliest weak step.
Follow the evaluator's frozen development/test split and permitted trial budget.
Evaluate the smallest repair and preserve failures.
improve-skill.check: Compare actual held-out behavior; structural checks alone do not prove better decisions.
improve-skill.stop: The leaf evaluator's bounded protocol completes or available authority/resources are insufficient.
improve-skill.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.
